title: Sewall.ai recorded runs
description: Recorded Sewall.ai workflow runs, each verified offline before publication. Live runs queried public NCBI, Earth Engine, NOAA and USGS sources through a fixed script, without a model. Review forums, panels and release gates use rule-based reviewers. Synthetic runs use fixture records and simulated policies. Open a report to inspect the graph, every source record and every event. No run establishes a biological finding.

runs.title: York River 2022: satellite chlorophyll proxy with review and release gate (live Earth Engine)
runs.note: Scripted Sentinel-2 NDCI and AlphaEarth summaries over the lower York River during the documented 2022 Margalefidinium polykrikoides bloom, with literature searches. Rule-based reviewers critique the run; the release gate holds the result while a major concern is contested. Run on October 14, 2026 with the earlier per-scene Sentinel-2 scene classification (SCL) water mask; see the revised-mask entry.

runs.title: York River 2022 at 30 m: release gate without review (live Earth Engine)
runs.note: The same site at 30 m AlphaEarth scale. With no review forum, the gate holds every monthly NDCI summary and the result.

runs.title: Lafayette River 2022: satellite chlorophyll proxy with review and release gate (live Earth Engine)
runs.note: Scripted Sentinel-2 NDCI and AlphaEarth summaries over the Lafayette River across summer 2022. Rule-based reviewers raise minor concerns; the gate releases outputs with limitations. Run on October 14, 2026 with the earlier per-scene Sentinel-2 scene classification (SCL) water mask; see the revised-mask entry.

runs.title: York River 2022, revised mask: daily mosaics over clear permanent water (live Earth Engine)
runs.note: The York River run repeated on October 16, 2026 with the revised Sentinel-2 Skill: one mosaic per day, JRC Global Surface Water permanent-water mask, per-pixel Cloud Score+ screening and a 100-pixel minimum. Rule-based reviewers critique the run; the release gate holds the result while a major concern is contested.

runs.title: Lafayette River 2022, revised mask: daily mosaics over clear permanent water (live Earth Engine)
runs.note: The Lafayette River run repeated on October 16, 2026 with the revised Sentinel-2 Skill. Rule-based reviewers raise minor concerns; the gate releases outputs with limitations.

runs.title: York River 2022: lab manager plan from rule-based dataset experts (live)
runs.note: Rule-based dataset-expert agents proposed Skill actions; the lab manager merged them into a capped script that the controller checked and ran.

runs.title: Chesapeake flood sensors: six areas with release gate (live NOAA and USGS)
runs.note: Latest public water levels and flood categories from NOAA NWPS, CO-OPS and USGS. Status no_evidence means no literature records; sensor readings are summaries. Provisional values and missing USGS flood thresholds release with limitations.

runs.title: M. polykrikoides growth-model evidence: lab manager consultation (live)
runs.note: Rule-based growth, NCBI, Earth Engine and EOL experts mapped a growth-model question onto searches for growth responses, interactions and LSU records (Figure 5 of the proposal).

runs.title: A. monilatum growth-model evidence: lab manager consultation (live)
runs.note: The same consultation for Alexandrium monilatum, where public growth-response and pathway evidence is thin.

runs.title: M. polykrikoides community interactions: lab manager consultation (live)
runs.note: Competition, allelopathy and bacterial interaction searches for the community-loss terms of a growth model.

runs.title: Chesapeake bloom: public metadata map (live NCBI)
runs.note: Scripted PubMed and BioProject searches plus GenBank inventories for two bloom-forming dinoflagellates. The script, not a model, chose the actions.

runs.title: Chesapeake bloom: controlled safe stop (live NCBI)
runs.note: The same question with one labeled fault injected after the first GenBank inventory. The run stops, quarantines the affected nodes and withholds its summary.

runs.title: Coastal plants: cross-scale graph (synthetic)
runs.note: Fixture records across genotype, expression, trait and environmental sources with deterministic replay.

runs.title: Coastal plants: missing link, run abstains (synthetic)
runs.note: A taxon match cannot stand in for missing specimen evidence, so the run abstains instead of joining on a guess.

runs.title: Coastal plants: denied policy, run abstains (synthetic)
runs.note: A simulated data-use policy prohibits the stated purpose. The affected source is blocked and the run abstains.

runs.title: Coastal plants: temporal leakage, run abstains (synthetic)
runs.note: A feature interval or its availability date falls after the historical forecast cutoff, so the run abstains.

runs.title: Safety supervisor: clean run (synthetic)
runs.note: The integrity supervisor completes without a critique.

runs.title: Safety supervisor: critical critique (synthetic)
runs.note: A critical critique stops dispatch and withdraws dependent outputs.

runs.title: Safety supervisor: tampered evidence (synthetic)
runs.note: Changed evidence fails its digest check and the run stops safely.

panels.title: Cross-run critique panel: York, Lafayette and the York consultation (2022)
panels.note: Rule-based researcher agents critique only each other's runs; owners answer or concede, and the moderator gives each run its own verdict, hash-chained to every manifest.
